project_title: Foundations of Randomness, Sample Spaces & Event Algebra
subject: Module-1: Probability (CSE & Applied Mathematics)
author: Prof. Locus

theory_fragments.content: In high-reliability computing, physical processes introduce unpredictable, stochastic behavior into deterministic silicon.
**Single Event Upset (SEU):** High-energy cosmic neutrons flip memory bitstates in satellite and cloud server RAM.
**Network Jitter & Collisions:** Asynchronous arrival times in packet routers introduce timing noise.
To build resilient software, we must formalize non-deterministic failure states using the rigorous framework of **Probability Theory**.

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<style>body { margin: 0; background: #0f172a; overflow: hidden; font-family: monospace; } canvas { display: block; width: 100vw; height: 100vh; }</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="stage" width="800" height="600"></canvas>
<script>
const canvas = document.getElementById('stage');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
let currentStep = 1;
let autoRotY = 0;
let isDragging = false, startX = 0, startY = 0, startTime = 0;
let dragRotX = 0.5, dragRotY = 0.6;

window.addEventListener('pointerdown', e => { startX = e.clientX; startY = e.clientY; startTime = Date.now(); isDragging = true; });
window.addEventListener('pointermove', e => {
  if (!isDragging) return;
  dragRotY += (e.clientX - startX) * 0.008;
  dragRotX += (e.clientY - startY) * 0.008;
  startX = e.clientX; startY = e.clientY;
});
window.addEventListener('pointerup', e => {
  isDragging = false;
  if (Math.abs(e.clientX - startX) < 10 && Math.abs(e.clientY - startY) < 10 && Date.now() - startTime < 300) {
    window.parent.postMessage({ action: e.clientX < window.innerWidth / 3 ? 'prevStep' : 'nextStep' }, '*');
  }
});

window.addEventListener('message', e => {
  if (e.data && typeof e.data.currentStep !== 'undefined') { currentStep = e.data.currentStep; }
});

function project(x, y, z) {
  let cx = Math.cos(dragRotX), sx = Math.sin(dragRotX);
  let cy = Math.cos(dragRotY + autoRotY), sy = Math.sin(dragRotY + autoRotY);
  let x1 = x * cy + z * sy;
  let z1 = -x * sy + z * cy;
  let y1 = y * cx - z1 * sx;
  let z2 = y * sx + z1 * cx;
  let f = 500 / (z2 + 500);
  return { x: 400 + x1 * f, y: 300 - y1 * f, scale: f };
}

let particles = [];
for(let i=0; i<30; i++) {
  particles.push({ x: (Math.random()-0.5)*200, y: 150 + Math.random()*100, z: (Math.random()-0.5)*200, speed: 2 + Math.random()*4 });
}
let gridFlips = {};

function loop() {
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#0f172a'; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 800, 600);
  if(!isDragging) autoRotY += 0.003;

  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  for(let i=-5; i<=5; i++) {
    let p1 = project(i*30, 0, -150);
    let p2 = project(i*30, 0, 150);
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#334155';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(p1.x, p1.y); ctx.lineTo(p2.x, p2.y); ctx.stroke();

    let p3 = project(-150, 0, i*30);
    let p4 = project(150, 0, i*30);
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(p3.x, p3.y); ctx.lineTo(p4.x, p4.y); ctx.stroke();
  }

  if(currentStep >= 2) {
    particles.forEach(p => {
      p.y -= p.speed;
      if(p.y < 0) {
        p.y = 200;
        p.x = (Math.random()-0.5)*260;
        p.z = (Math.random()-0.5)*260;
        let gx = Math.floor((p.x+150)/30);
        let gz = Math.floor((p.z+150)/30);
        if(gx>=0 && gx<10 && gz>=0 && gz<10) {
          let key = gx + '_' + gz;
          gridFlips[key] = (gridFlips[key] || 0) + 1;
        }
      }
      let pp = project(p.x, p.y, p.z);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#f43f5e';
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(pp.x, pp.y, 3*pp.scale, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    });
  }

  Object.keys(gridFlips).forEach(k => {
    let parts = k.split('_');
    let gx = parseInt(parts[0])*30 - 135;
    let gz = parseInt(parts[1])*30 - 135;
    let gp = project(gx, 0, gz);
    ctx.fillStyle = gridFlips[k] > 3 ? '#f43f5e' : '#fbbf24';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(gp.x, gp.y, 5*gp.scale, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  });

  ctx.fillStyle = '#00E5FF'; ctx.font = '16px monospace';
  ctx.fillText("3D Silicon Wafer | Cosmic Ray Impact Simulation", 20, 30);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#10b981';
  let totalFlips = Object.values(gridFlips).reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0);
  ctx.fillText(`Bit-Flip Errors Detected: ${totalFlips}`, 20, 55);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#64748b';
  ctx.fillText("Step " + currentStep + ": " + (currentStep===1?"Baseline Silicon Matrix": currentStep===2?"Cosmic Particle Radiation Active":"Bit-Flip Fault Accumulation"), 20, 570);
}
loop();
</script>
</body>
</html>

theory_fragments.content: A **Random Experiment** $\mathcal{E}$ is any repeatable procedure whose outcome cannot be predicted with certainty prior to execution.
**Property 1:** The set of all possible individual outcomes is known in advance.
**Property 2:** Any single execution (a **trial**) yields a single outcome that cannot be known prior to completion.
**Property 3:** The experiment can be repeated under identical conditions.

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<style>body { margin: 0; background: #0f172a; overflow: hidden; font-family: monospace; } canvas { display: block; width: 100vw; height: 100vh; }</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="stage" width="800" height="600"></canvas>
<script>
const canvas = document.getElementById('stage');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
let currentStep = 1;
let startX = 0, startY = 0, startTime = 0;

window.addEventListener('pointerdown', e => { startX = e.clientX; startY = e.clientY; startTime = Date.now(); });
window.addEventListener('pointerup', e => {
  if (Math.abs(e.clientX - startX) < 10 && Math.abs(e.clientY - startY) < 10 && Date.now() - startTime < 300) {
    window.parent.postMessage({ action: e.clientX < window.innerWidth / 3 ? 'prevStep' : 'nextStep' }, '*');
  }
});

window.addEventListener('message', e => {
  if (e.data && typeof e.data.currentStep !== 'undefined') { currentStep = e.data.currentStep; }
});

let balls = [];
let bins = new Array(11).fill(0);

function spawnBall() {
  balls.push({ x: 400, y: 50, vx: 0, vy: 0 });
}

function loop() {
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#0f172a'; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 800, 600);

  let spawnRate = currentStep === 1 ? 0 : currentStep === 2 ? 0.08 : 0.3;
  if (Math.random() < spawnRate) spawnBall();

  ctx.fillStyle = '#00E5FF';
  let rows = 8;
  for (let r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
    let startXRow = 400 - (r * 20);
    for (let c = 0; c <= r; c++) {
      let px = startXRow + c * 40;
      let py = 100 + r * 35;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(px, py, 4, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    }
  }

  for (let i = balls.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    let b = balls[i];
    b.vy += 0.2;
    b.y += b.vy;
    b.x += b.vx;

    let r = Math.floor((b.y - 100) / 35);
    if (r >= 0 && r < rows && b.y > 100 + r * 35 && b.y < 100 + r * 35 + 10) {
      b.vx += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1.5;
    }

    if (b.y > 400) {
      let binIdx = Math.floor((b.x - 180) / 40);
      binIdx = Math.max(0, Math.min(10, binIdx));
      bins[binIdx]++;
      balls.splice(i, 1);
    } else {
      ctx.fillStyle = '#fbbf24';
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(b.x, b.y, 4, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    }
  }

  let maxCount = Math.max(1, Math.max(...bins));
  for (let i = 0; i < 11; i++) {
    let bx = 200 + i * 40;
    let h = (bins[i] / maxCount) * 120;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#10b981';
    ctx.fillRect(bx - 15, 550 - h, 30, h);
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#334155';
    ctx.strokeRect(bx - 15, 430, 30, 120);
  }

  ctx.fillStyle = '#00E5FF'; ctx.font = '16px monospace';
  ctx.fillText("Galton Board Random Experiment Simulation", 20, 30);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#10b981';
  ctx.fillText(`Total Trial Samples Generated: ${bins.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)}`, 20, 55);
}
loop();
</script>
</body>
</html>

slides.title: Defining the Universe: Sample Space
slides.subtitle: Discrete Finite, Discrete Infinite, and Continuous Manifolds

theory_fragments.content: The **Sample Space** $\Omega$ (or $S$) is the set of all possible elementary outcomes $\omega$ of a random experiment.
\Omega = \{ \omega_1, \omega_2, \omega_3, \dots \}
**Discrete Finite:** Flip 3 bits $\implies \Omega = \{000, 001, \dots, 111\}, |\Omega| = 2^3 = 8$.
**Discrete Infinite:** Number of packet retries until success $\implies \Omega = \{1, 2, 3, \dots\}$.
**Continuous Manifold:** Voltage fluctuations in CPU clock line $\implies \Omega = [V_{min}, V_{max}] \subset \mathbb{R}$.

  let cx = Math.cos(dragRotX), sx = Math.sin(dragRotX);
  let cy = Math.cos(dragRotY + autoRotY), sy = Math.sin(dragRotY + autoRotY);
  let x1 = x * cy + z * sy;
  let z1 = -x * sy + z * cy;
  let y1 = y * cx - z1 * sx;
  let z2 = y * sx + z1 * cx;
  let f = 500 / (z2 + 500);
  return { x: 400 + x1 * f, y: 300 - y1 * f, scale: f };
}

function loop() {
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#0f172a'; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 800, 600);
  if(!isDragging) autoRotY += 0.003;

  let s = 120;
  let vertices = [
    [-s,-s,-s], [s,-s,-s], [s,s,-s], [-s,s,-s],
    [-s,-s,s],  [s,-s,s],  [s,s,s],  [-s,s,s]
  ];
  let edges = [
    [0,1],[1,2],[2,3],[3,0],
    [4,5],[5,6],[6,7],[7,4],
    [0,4],[1,5],[2,6],[3,7]
  ];

  ctx.strokeStyle = '#00E5FF'; ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  edges.forEach(e => {
    let p1 = project(...vertices[e[0]]);
    let p2 = project(...vertices[e[1]]);
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(p1.x, p1.y); ctx.lineTo(p2.x, p2.y); ctx.stroke();
  });

  if (currentStep === 1) {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fbbf24';
    for(let x=-1; x<=1; x++) {
      for(let y=-1; y<=1; y++) {
        for(let z=-1; z<=1; z++) {
          let p = project(x*s, y*s, z*s);
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, 6*p.scale, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
        }
      }
    }
  } else {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.2)';
    let pTop = project(0,0,0);
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(pTop.x, pTop.y, 100*pTop.scale, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();

    ctx.fillStyle = '#10b981';
    for(let i=0; i<150; i++) {
      let rx = (Math.sin(i*1.1))*s*0.8;
      let ry = (Math.cos(i*1.7))*s*0.8;
      let rz = (Math.sin(i*2.3))*s*0.8;
      let p = project(rx, ry, rz);
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, 3*p.scale, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    }
  }

  ctx.fillStyle = '#00E5FF'; ctx.font = '16px monospace';
  ctx.fillText("3D State Space Explorer: " + (currentStep===1 ? "Discrete Lattice Sample Space" : "Continuous Manifold Volume"), 20, 30);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#64748b';
  ctx.fillText("Drag to rotate 360° | Click slide to toggle discrete vs. continuous", 20, 570);
}
loop();
</script>

slides.title: Events as Measurable Subsets
slides.subtitle: Formalizing Events within the Power Set

theory_fragments.content: An **Event** $E$ is any subset of the sample space $\Omega$, formally belonging to the event space $\mathcal{F} \subseteq \mathcal{P}(\Omega)$.
E \subseteq \Omega \implies E \in \mathcal{F}
**Elementary Event:** A single outcome subset $E = \{\omega_i\}$.
**Certain Event:** The entire space $\Omega$; it must occur in every trial.
**Impossible Event:** The empty set $\emptyset$; contains zero outcomes.

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<style>body { margin: 0; background: #0f172a; overflow: hidden; font-family: monospace; } canvas { display: block; width: 100vw; height: 100vh; }</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="stage" width="800" height="600"></canvas>
<script>
const canvas = document.getElementById('stage');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
let currentStep = 1;
let startX = 0, startY = 0, startTime = 0;

let points = [];
for(let i=0; i<25; i++) {
  points.push({ x: 150 + Math.random()*500, y: 150 + Math.random()*300, id: i });
}

let box = { x: 250, y: 200, w: 300, h: 200 };
let isBoxDragging = false, dragOffX = 0, dragOffY = 0;

window.addEventListener('pointerdown', e => {
  startX = e.clientX; startY = e.clientY; startTime = Date.now();
  if(e.clientX >= box.x && e.clientX <= box.x + box.w && e.clientY >= box.y && e.clientY <= box.y + box.h) {
    isBoxDragging = true;
    dragOffX = e.clientX - box.x;
    dragOffY = e.clientY - box.y;
  }
});

window.addEventListener('pointermove', e => {
  if(isBoxDragging) {
    box.x = e.clientX - dragOffX;
    box.y = e.clientY - dragOffY;
  }
});

window.addEventListener('pointerup', e => {
  isBoxDragging = false;
  if (Math.abs(e.clientX - startX) < 10 && Math.abs(e.clientY - startY) < 10 && Date.now() - startTime < 300) {
    window.parent.postMessage({ action: e.clientX < window.innerWidth / 3 ? 'prevStep' : 'nextStep' }, '*');
  }
});

window.addEventListener('message', e => {
  if (e.data && typeof e.data.currentStep !== 'undefined') { currentStep = e.data.currentStep; }
});

function loop() {
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#0f172a'; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 800, 600);

  ctx.strokeStyle = '#64748b'; ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.strokeRect(100, 100, 600, 400);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#64748b'; ctx.font = '18px monospace';
  ctx.fillText("Universal Sample Space (Ω)", 120, 130);

  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.15)';
  ctx.fillRect(box.x, box.y, box.w, box.h);
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#00E5FF'; ctx.lineWidth = 3;
  ctx.strokeRect(box.x, box.y, box.w, box.h);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#00E5FF';
  ctx.fillText("Event Subset E", box.x + 15, box.y + 30);

  let countE = 0;
  points.forEach(p => {
    let inside = (p.x >= box.x && p.x <= box.x + box.w && p.y >= box.y && p.y <= box.y + box.h);
    if(inside) countE++;
    ctx.fillStyle = inside ? '#10b981' : '#fbbf24';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, 7, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  });

  ctx.fillStyle = '#00E5FF'; ctx.font = '16px monospace';
  ctx.fillText("Events as Subsets: Drag the cyan Event E region", 20, 30);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#10b981';
  ctx.fillText(`Outcomes in Event E |E| = ${countE} / 25 | Ratio = ${(countE/25).toFixed(2)}`, 20, 55);
}
loop();
</script>
</body>
</html>

theory_fragments.content: Operations on events map directly to set-theoretic operations on the sample space $\Omega$:
**Union ($A \cup B$):** Event $A$ OR Event $B$ occurs (at least one occurs).
**Intersection ($A \cap B$):** Event $A$ AND Event $B$ occur simultaneously.
**Complement ($A^c$ or $A'$):** Event $A$ does NOT occur.
**Mutually Exclusive:** $A \cap B = \emptyset$. They cannot co-occur.

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<style>body { margin: 0; background: #0f172a; overflow: hidden; font-family: monospace; } canvas { display: block; width: 100vw; height: 100vh; }</style>

<body>
<canvas id="stage" width="800" height="600"></canvas>
<script>
const canvas = document.getElementById('stage');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
let currentStep = 1;
let startX = 0, startY = 0, startTime = 0;

window.addEventListener('pointerdown', e => { startX = e.clientX; startY = e.clientY; startTime = Date.now(); });
window.addEventListener('pointerup', e => {
  if (Math.abs(e.clientX - startX) < 10 && Math.abs(e.clientY - startY) < 10 && Date.now() - startTime < 300) {
    window.parent.postMessage({ action: e.clientX < window.innerWidth / 3 ? 'prevStep' : 'nextStep' }, '*');
  }
});

window.addEventListener('message', e => {
  if (e.data && typeof e.data.currentStep !== 'undefined') { currentStep = e.data.currentStep; }
});

function loop() {
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#0f172a'; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 800, 600);

  let cA = { x: 330, y: 300, r: 120 };
  let cB = { x: 470, y: 300, r: 120 };

  ctx.strokeStyle = '#00E5FF'; ctx.lineWidth = 3;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cA.x, cA.y, cA.r, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#10b981';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cB.x, cB.y, cB.r, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.stroke();

  ctx.fillStyle = '#00E5FF'; ctx.font = '20px monospace';
  ctx.fillText("A", cA.x - 50, cA.y);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#10b981';
  ctx.fillText("B", cB.x + 40, cB.y);

  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(251, 191, 36, 0.4)';
  if (currentStep === 1) {
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cA.x, cA.y, cA.r, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cB.x, cB.y, cB.r, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  } else if (currentStep === 2) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cA.x, cA.y, cA.r, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.clip();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cB.x, cB.y, cB.r, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  } else if (currentStep >= 3) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cA.x, cA.y, cA.r, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'destination-out';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cB.x, cB.y, cB.r, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  ctx.fillStyle = '#00E5FF'; ctx.font = '16px monospace';
  ctx.fillText("Set Operations Visualizer", 20, 30);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fbbf24'; ctx.font = '18px monospace';
  let modeText = currentStep === 1 ? "A ∪ B (Union: A OR B)" : currentStep === 2 ? "A ∩ B (Intersection: A AND B)" : "A \\ B (Difference: A AND NOT B)";
  ctx.fillText("Active Mode: " + modeText, 20, 60);
}
loop();
</script>
</body>
</html>

slides.title: De Morgan's Laws in System Reliability
slides.subtitle: Duality of Series vs. Parallel Component Failures

theory_fragments.content: De Morgan’s Laws establish fundamental dualities between set unions and intersections:
(A \cup B)^c = A^c \cap B^c
(A \cap B)^c = A^c \cup B^c
**Reliability Interpretation:** A parallel system fails iff Component A fails AND Component B fails: $(A \cup B)^c = A^c \cap B^c$.

const canvas = document.getElementById('stage');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
let currentStep = 1;
let startX = 0, startY = 0, startTime = 0;

  ctx.strokeStyle = '#334155'; ctx.lineWidth = 4;
  if (currentStep === 1) {
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(100, 300); ctx.lineTo(250, 300); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.strokeRect(250, 260, 100, 80);
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(350, 300); ctx.lineTo(450, 300); ctx.stroke();

    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(200, 200); ctx.lineTo(300, 200); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.strokeRect(300, 160, 100, 80);
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(400, 200); ctx.lineTo(500, 200); ctx.stroke();

    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(200, 400); ctx.lineTo(300, 400); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.strokeRect(300, 360, 100, 80);
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(400, 400); ctx.lineTo(500, 400); ctx.stroke();

    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(500, 200); ctx.lineTo(500, 400); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(500, 300); ctx.lineTo(700, 300); ctx.stroke();

    ctx.fillStyle = '#10b981'; ctx.font = '18px monospace';
    ctx.fillText("Comp A", 315, 205); ctx.fillText("Comp B", 315, 405);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fbbf24';
    ctx.fillText("Parallel System Fails ONLY if A Fails AND B Fails: (A^c ∩ B^c)", 80, 100);
  }

  ctx.fillStyle = '#00E5FF'; ctx.font = '16px monospace';
  ctx.fillText("De Morgan's Reliability Duality: (A ∪ B)^c = A^c ∩ B^c", 20, 30);
}
loop();
</script>
</body>
</html>

theory_fragments.content: When sample spaces are uncountably infinite continuous regions $\Omega \subset \mathbb{R}^n$, individual points have zero probability $P(\{\omega\}) = 0$.
Probability is calculated using geometric measures (Length, Area, Volume):
P(E) = \frac{\text{Area}(E)}{\text{Area}(\Omega)}
In the Monte Carlo simulation (right), random dart throws approximate this ratio empirically.

media_panel.src:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<style>body { margin: 0; background: #0f172a; overflow: hidden; font-family: monospace; } canvas { display: block; width: 100vw; height: 100vh; }</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="stage" width="800" height="600"></canvas>
<script>
const canvas = document.getElementById('stage');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
let currentStep = 1;
let startX = 0, startY = 0, startTime = 0;

let darts = [];

window.addEventListener('pointerdown', e => { startX = e.clientX; startY = e.clientY; startTime = Date.now(); });
window.addEventListener('pointerup', e => {
  if (Math.abs(e.clientX - startX) < 10 && Math.abs(e.clientY - startY) < 10 && Date.now() - startTime < 300) {
    window.parent.postMessage({ action: e.clientX < window.innerWidth / 3 ? 'prevStep' : 'nextStep' }, '*');
  }
});

window.addEventListener('message', e => {
  if (e.data && typeof e.data.currentStep !== 'undefined') { currentStep = e.data.currentStep; }
});

function loop() {
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#0f172a'; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 800, 600);

  for(let i=0; i<(currentStep===1?2:15); i++) {
    let dx = 200 + Math.random()*400;
    let dy = 100 + Math.random()*400;
    let hit = Math.hypot(dx-400, dy-300) <= 120;
    darts.push({ x: dx, y: dy, hit: hit });
  }

  ctx.strokeStyle = '#64748b'; ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.strokeRect(200, 100, 400, 400);

  ctx.strokeStyle = '#00E5FF'; ctx.lineWidth = 3;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(400, 300, 120, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.stroke();

  darts.forEach(d => {
    ctx.fillStyle = d.hit ? '#10b981' : '#f43f5e';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(d.x, d.y, 3, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  });

  let hits = darts.filter(d => d.hit).length;
  let total = darts.length;
  let empirical = total > 0 ? (hits/total).toFixed(4) : "0.0000";
  let theoretical = (Math.PI * 120 * 120 / (400 * 400)).toFixed(4);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#00E5FF'; ctx.font = '16px monospace';
  ctx.fillText("Geometric Probability Engine: P(E) = Area(E) / Area(Ω)", 20, 30);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#10b981';
  ctx.fillText(`Empirical Ratio: ${hits}/${total} = ${empirical} | Theoretical: π(120)^2 / 400^2 = ${theoretical}`, 20, 55);
}
loop();
</script>
</body>
</html>

theory_fragments.content: Interactive Workbench: Drag Sets $A$ (cyan) and $B$ (green) across the universal canvas $\Omega$.
When sets separate beyond distance $r_A + r_B$, intersection drops to zero: $A \cap B = \emptyset$.
As sets overlap, the golden region highlights joint probability density $P(A \cap B)$.

media_panel.src:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<style>body { margin: 0; background: #0f172a; overflow: hidden; font-family: monospace; } canvas { display: block; width: 100vw; height: 100vh; }</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="stage" width="800" height="600"></canvas>
<script>
const canvas = document.getElementById('stage');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
let currentStep = 1;
let startX = 0, startY = 0, startTime = 0;

let setA = { x: 350, y: 300, r: 130 };
let setB = { x: 450, y: 300, r: 130 };
let isDraggingA = false, isDraggingB = false;

window.addEventListener('pointerdown', e => {
  startX = e.clientX; startY = e.clientY; startTime = Date.now();
  if(Math.hypot(e.clientX - setA.x, e.clientY - setA.y) < setA.r) isDraggingA = true;
  else if(Math.hypot(e.clientX - setB.x, e.clientY - setB.y) < setB.r) isDraggingB = true;
});

window.addEventListener('pointermove', e => {
  if(isDraggingA) { setA.x = e.clientX; setA.y = e.clientY; }
  if(isDraggingB) { setB.x = e.clientX; setB.y = e.clientY; }
});

window.addEventListener('pointerup', e => {
  isDraggingA = false; isDraggingB = false;
  if (Math.abs(e.clientX - startX) < 10 && Math.abs(e.clientY - startY) < 10 && Date.now() - startTime < 300) {
    window.parent.postMessage({ action: e.clientX < window.innerWidth / 3 ? 'prevStep' : 'nextStep' }, '*');
  }
});

window.addEventListener('message', e => {
  if (e.data && typeof e.data.currentStep !== 'undefined') { currentStep = e.data.currentStep; }
});

function loop() {
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#0f172a'; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 800, 600);

  ctx.strokeStyle = '#334155'; ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.strokeRect(80, 80, 640, 440);

  ctx.strokeStyle = '#00E5FF'; ctx.lineWidth = 3;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(setA.x, setA.y, setA.r, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#10b981';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(setB.x, setB.y, setB.r, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.stroke();

  ctx.save();
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(setA.x, setA.y, setA.r, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.clip();
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(setB.x, setB.y, setB.r, 0, Math.PI*2);
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(251, 191, 36, 0.4)'; ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();

  let d = Math.hypot(setA.x - setB.x, setA.y - setB.y);
  let isDisjoint = d > (setA.r + setB.r);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#00E5FF'; ctx.font = '16px monospace';
  ctx.fillText("Interactive Set Engine: Drag Sets A & B", 20, 30);
  ctx.fillStyle = isDisjoint ? '#f43f5e' : '#fbbf24';
  ctx.fillText(isDisjoint ? "Sets are Mutually Exclusive! P(A ∩ B) = 0" : `Sets Overlap! Distance d = ${d.toFixed(1)}px`, 20, 55);
}
loop();
</script>
</body>
</html>

slides.title: Engineering Application: Router Packet Faults
slides.subtitle: Stochastic Modeling of Network Buffer Drops

theory_fragments.content: Consider a 4-node network router mesh. Let event $E_i$ be the event that link $i$ drops a packet due to buffer overflow.
The sample space $\Omega = \{0, 1\}^4$ contains $2^4 = 16$ binary link state vectors.
Event $A$: Total transmission success (zero dropped packets) $\implies A = \{(0,0,0,0)\}$.
Event $B$: At least one link drops a packet $\implies B = A^c$.

media_panel.src:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<style>body { margin: 0; background: #0f172a; overflow: hidden; font-family: monospace; } canvas { display: block; width: 100vw; height: 100vh; }</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="stage" width="800" height="600"></canvas>
<script>
const canvas = document.getElementById('stage');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
let currentStep = 1;
let startX = 0, startY = 0, startTime = 0;

let nodes = [
  { id: 'R1', x: 200, y: 200 }, { id: 'R2', x: 600, y: 200 },
  { id: 'R3', x: 200, y: 400 }, { id: 'R4', x: 600, y: 400 }
];
let packets = [];

window.addEventListener('pointerdown', e => { startX = e.clientX; startY = e.clientY; startTime = Date.now(); });
window.addEventListener('pointerup', e => {
  if (Math.abs(e.clientX - startX) < 10 && Math.abs(e.clientY - startY) < 10 && Date.now() - startTime < 300) {
    window.parent.postMessage({ action: e.clientX < window.innerWidth / 3 ? 'prevStep' : 'nextStep' }, '*');
  }
});

window.addEventListener('message', e => {
  if (e.data && typeof e.data.currentStep !== 'undefined') { currentStep = e.data.currentStep; }
});

function loop() {
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#0f172a'; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 800, 600);

  ctx.strokeStyle = '#334155'; ctx.lineWidth = 3;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(nodes[0].x, nodes[0].y); ctx.lineTo(nodes[1].x, nodes[1].y); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(nodes[0].x, nodes[0].y); ctx.lineTo(nodes[2].x, nodes[2].y); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(nodes[1].x, nodes[1].y); ctx.lineTo(nodes[3].x, nodes[3].y); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(nodes[2].x, nodes[2].y); ctx.lineTo(nodes[3].x, nodes[3].y); ctx.stroke();

  if(Math.random() < 0.1) {
    packets.push({ x: nodes[0].x, y: nodes[0].y, targetX: nodes[1].x, targetY: nodes[1].y, progress: 0 });
  }

  for(let i=packets.length-1; i>=0; i--) {
    let p = packets[i];
    p.progress += 0.02;
    let px = p.x + (p.targetX - p.x)*p.progress;
    let py = p.y + (p.targetY - p.y)*p.progress;

    if(currentStep >= 2 && p.progress > 0.5 && Math.random() < 0.05) {
      ctx.fillStyle = '#f43f5e'; ctx.font = '14px monospace';
      ctx.fillText("DROP!", px, py);
      packets.splice(i, 1);
      continue;
    }

    if(p.progress >= 1) packets.splice(i, 1);
    else {
      ctx.fillStyle = '#00E5FF';
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(px, py, 5, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    }
  }

  nodes.forEach(n => {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#10b981';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(n.x, n.y, 25, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#0f172a'; ctx.font = 'bold 16px monospace';
    ctx.fillText(n.id, n.x-10, n.y+5);
  });

  ctx.fillStyle = '#00E5FF'; ctx.font = '16px monospace';
  ctx.fillText("4-Node Router Topology: Packet Fault Modeling", 20, 30);
  ctx.fillStyle = currentStep === 1 ? '#10b981' : '#f43f5e';
  ctx.fillText("Network State: " + (currentStep === 1 ? "Ideal Transmission" : "Buffer Congestion (Packet Drops Active)"), 20, 55);
}
loop();
</script>
</body>
</html>

slides.title: Algorithmic Encoding: Bitmask Register ALU
slides.subtitle: Executing Set Operations via CPU Bitwise Logic

theory_fragments.content: In high-performance software engines, event sets are represented as 64-bit integer bitmasks.
**Intersection ($A \cap B$):** Computed via single-cycle Bitwise `AND` (`A & B`).
**Union ($A \cup B$):** Computed via single-cycle Bitwise `OR` (`A | B`).
**Complement ($A^c$):** Computed via Bitwise `NOT` (`~A`).

media_panel.src:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<style>body { margin: 0; background: #0f172a; overflow: hidden; font-family: monospace; } canvas { display: block; width: 100vw; height: 100vh; }</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="stage" width="800" height="600"></canvas>
<script>
const canvas = document.getElementById('stage');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
let currentStep = 1;
let startX = 0, startY = 0, startTime = 0;

let maskA = 0b1100101011010011;
let maskB = 0b1011100101100110;

window.addEventListener('pointerdown', e => { startX = e.clientX; startY = e.clientY; startTime = Date.now(); });
window.addEventListener('pointerup', e => {
  if (Math.abs(e.clientX - startX) < 10 && Math.abs(e.clientY - startY) < 10 && Date.now() - startTime < 300) {
    window.parent.postMessage({ action: e.clientX < window.innerWidth / 3 ? 'prevStep' : 'nextStep' }, '*');
  }
});

window.addEventListener('message', e => {
  if (e.data && typeof e.data.currentStep !== 'undefined') { currentStep = e.data.currentStep; }
});

function drawBitRow(y, label, val, color) {
  ctx.fillStyle = color; ctx.font = '16px monospace';
  ctx.fillText(label, 50, y + 20);
  for(let i=15; i>=0; i--) {
    let bit = (val >> i) & 1;
    let x = 200 + (15 - i) * 32;
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#334155'; ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.strokeRect(x, y, 28, 30);
    ctx.fillStyle = bit ? color : '#1e293b';
    ctx.fillRect(x+2, y+2, 24, 26);
    ctx.fillStyle = bit ? '#0f172a' : '#64748b'; ctx.font = 'bold 14px monospace';
    ctx.fillText(bit, x+10, y+20);
  }
}

function loop() {
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#0f172a'; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 800, 600);

  drawBitRow(150, "Event A Mask :", maskA, '#00E5FF');
  drawBitRow(220, "Event B Mask :", maskB, '#10b981');

  if (currentStep === 1) {
    drawBitRow(340, "A ∩ B (AND)  :", maskA & maskB, '#fbbf24');
  } else if (currentStep >= 2) {
    drawBitRow(340, "A ∪ B (OR)   :", maskA | maskB, '#f43f5e');
  }

  ctx.fillStyle = '#00E5FF'; ctx.font = '16px monospace';
  ctx.fillText("Algorithmic Event Encoding: CPU Bitmask Register ALU", 20, 30);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fbbf24';
  ctx.fillText("Step " + currentStep + " ALU Operation: " + (currentStep===1 ? "Bitwise AND for Intersection" : "Bitwise OR for Union"), 20, 55);
}
loop();
</script>
</body>
</html>

theory_fragments.content: **Foundations of Randomness & Event Algebra Summary:**
**Random Experiment (\mathcal{E}):** Repeatable trial with non-deterministic single outcomes.
**Sample Space (\Omega):** The exhaustive universe of all possible elementary outcomes \omega.
**Event Space (\mathcal{F}):** Measurable subsets E \subseteq \Omega; closed under unions and complements.
**De Morgan Duality:** (A \cup B)^c = A^c \cap B^c; critical for software system fault analysis.
